Dr. Jun Reyes background 

Dr. Juanito Reyes PT DPT received his bachelor of Physical Therapy from Emilio Aguinaldo College in 1999. He has worked in multiple settings such as orthopedic, neurological, and geriatrics for more than 10 years. Dr. Reyes is a board certified physical therapist in both Philippines and NY, USA and his graduate work includes Transitional Doctoral Degree in Physical Therapy from Stony Brook University and received S. Herdman vestibular rehabilitation training from Emory University.
